chunks: 4513 - Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Mālik ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

A woman came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and said: “O Messenger of Allah, what is the right of the husband over the woman?” So he said to her: “She is to obey him and not disobey him. She is not to give anything in charity from his house except with his permission, and she is not to observe a voluntary fast except with his permission. She is not to withhold herself from him, even if she is upon the back of a saddle. And she is not to leave her house except with his permission. If she leaves without his permission, the angels of the heaven, the angels of the earth, the angels of wrath, and the angels of mercy curse her until she returns to her house.”

She said: “O Messenger of Allah, who has the greatest right over a man?” He said: “His parents.” She said: “Then who has the greatest right over a woman?” He said: “Her husband.” She said: “So do I have over him a right similar to what he has over me?” He said: “No, not even one out of every hundred.”
So she said: “By the One who sent you with the truth as a Prophet, no man shall ever possess my neck.”

key_terms.تَطَوُّعًا: an optional or supererogatory act, here voluntary fasting
key_terms.تُطِيعُهُ: she obeys him in what is due to him
key_terms.حَقُّ: a due right or entitlement owed to another
key_terms.رَقَبَتِي: my neck, an expression referring to personal subjection or authority over oneself
key_terms.ٱلزَّوْجِ: the husband within the marital relationship

ai.seo_question: What rights does a husband have over his wife according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a woman's question to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله about the rights of a husband over his wife and presents a set of marital obligations in that context. It also compares the hierarchy of rights, stating that parents have the greatest right over a man, while a husband has the greatest right over a woman, emphasizing the gravity of spousal rights in family law and social relations.
